title: SA-V2X training sample: infrastructure-side case
description: One scene at decision time t0 as seen by the RSU / edge computer at the intersection. Inputs: every SDSM object the RSU's own perception produced (local, near-zero link latency), BSMs received over the air from connected vehicles (which J3224 excludes from the SDSM, so they must be fused), and SPaT from the controller. Every agent is a prediction target. One JSON object per line in .jsonl.gz.

agents.description: Vehicles on all four approaches and VRUs near the target crosswalk, capped by distance to the crosswalk.

conflicts.description: Realized vehicle-pedestrian interval pairs at the target crosswalk within the label horizon. Labels only.
